eori.title: EORI number
eori.description: One EORI number with its country prefix, e.g. DE123456789012345 or NL123456789. Spaces, dots and dashes are ignored. Leave empty when you use 'EORI numbers (batch)'.

eoris.title: EORI numbers (batch)
eoris.description: Up to 500 EORI numbers per run. Clear the single 'EORI number' field when you use this.
